tests.name: Cross-Mandal Composite FK Enforcement
tests.observed: 23503: insert or update on table "mandals" violates foreign key constraint "fk_mandals_current_version_same_anchor"
tests.details: Cross-mandal assignment rejected by composite same-anchor FK

tests.name: Anchor Cannot Reference Inactive Version
tests.observed: 23514: INTEGRITY VIOLATION [ERR-W014-001]: mandals.current_version_id (9e769823-73b6-4954-b067-6d325b8607c8) must reference an active version (is_current = true) belonging to mandal TS-MDL-7103
tests.details: Reference to inactive version fails closed via trg_guard_mandal_current_version

tests.name: Referenced Current Version Retirement Guard
tests.requirement: Cannot retire active version while referenced by current_version_id
tests.observed: 23514: INTEGRITY VIOLATION [ERR-W014-002]: Cannot deactivate (is_current=false) or delete mandal_version 2c7c1aa8-a86a-46db-94d7-60e798353ce5 while it is actively referenced by mandals.current_version_id. Transition mandal to an active successor version or clear current_version_id first via fn_transition_mandal_current_version().

tests.name: Single Current Version per Mandal (Partial Unique Index)
tests.requirement: At most one is_current=true per mandal_id
tests.observed: 23P01: conflicting key value violates exclusion constraint "uq_mandal_versions_no_overlap"
tests.details: Second active version rejected with unique_violation

tests.name: Direct Invalid Mutation Fail-Closed
tests.requirement: Invalid FK and inverted temporal range rejected

tests.name: Atomic Valid Transition Succeeds
tests.requirement: fn_transition_mandal_current_version atomically transitions version and pointer
tests.details: Atomic transition successfully retires previous version, activates new version, and updates pointer

tests.name: Candidate Versions Excluded from Canonical Truth
tests.requirement: Candidate is_current=false versions cannot be returned as canonical legal truth
tests.expected: Excluded from canonical pointer and active views
tests.details: Candidate version completely isolated from canonical views

tests.name: Non-OFFICIAL Dataset Cannot Become Canonical
tests.details: Trigger Layer 2 enforces W012 institutional authority

tests.name: Active Version with Non-Null valid_to Rejected
tests.requirement: chk_mandal_versions_current_invariants enforces is_current => valid_to IS NULL
tests.observed: 23514: new row for relation "mandal_versions" violates check constraint "chk_mandal_versions_current_invariants"
tests.details: Calendar-independent check constraint rejects valid_to on active version

tests.name: Direct Closure of Current Version Rejected
tests.requirement: Direct closure of referenced version rejected by check constraint & retirement trigger
tests.details: Bypassing transition function to directly close active version fails closed

tests.name: Valid OFFICIAL Open-Ended Transition
tests.requirement: Open-ended candidate on OFFICIAL dataset successfully transitions with full JSONB receipt
tests.details: Full transition lifecycle produces valid audit receipt

tests.name: UNVERIFIED Candidate Transition Rejected
tests.requirement: Transition function rejects candidate version from non-OFFICIAL dataset
tests.details: W012 dataset governance prevents elevation of UNVERIFIED candidate via transition function

tests.name: Privilege Boundary & ACL Enforcement
tests.requirement: PUBLIC/anon denied EXECUTE; anonymous DML denied by RLS
tests.details: PostgreSQL declarative ACL blocks anonymous transition function execution and DML

tests.name: p_operator Zero Privilege Matrix
tests.requirement: p_operator text parameter cannot elevate unauthorized caller
tests.details: Caller authorization enforced exclusively by PostgreSQL EXECUTE ACL, p_operator is audit-only
